_about: Spec 48 FR-48-96: how the order confirmation's holes, branches and order lines become the order's own blocks, read by lib/template-piece-order-read.mjs and lib/template-piece-order.mjs. Structure decides first: a value reads the order when the logic derives it from the object the order lines loop takes its list from, a currency amount is one a currency formatter makes, a link to the order carries the order's reference, a branch is a gift or account branch when its test reads that part of the order. These words only choose between keys the structure leaves open (which field of the order a value reads), the way data/shop-part-vocab.json's hints are used: a value no key's words and structure fit is a problem row, never a guess. `keys`: each binding key of the plugin's sgs/order source (plugins/sgs-blocks/includes/class-order-binding.php::Order_Binding::KEYS; a key named here that the plugin does not hold is refused) with the evidence it needs: `money` (the value is a currency amount), `reference` (the value is the order's reference: a link to the order carries it, or its sample has an order reference's shape), `link` (a link whose address carries the reference), `group` (the field sits under that group's part of the order), `words` (whole words of the field's path, camelCase split). `viewable`: the Show-to rule a bound block outside every order branch takes, so its words (the draft's sample order) never show when the visitor may not view the order and the binding resolves to nothing. `groups`: parts of the order a branch can test, each with the Show-to rule for a branch shown when the part is there (`shown`) and when it is not (`hidden`), values of the block extension the framework database lists (a rule the database does not list is refused). `items`: the sgs/order-items settings the draft's order lines answer, each checked against the framework database before it is written; `rows` are the totals rows the draft may draw after the lines, each with the words of its field. Site-supplied facts: a value of an element's words that the logic derives from the order and that no key above holds (a bake date) is bound to `fact:<name>` (the name is its field path's words joined with `_`, `bake_date`) when the plugin holds that form (`Order_Binding::FACT_PREFIX` and `FACT_FILTER`, read by lib/template-piece-order-plugin.mjs), and the run report notes it as a "site-supplied fact": the site answers through the plugin's `sgs_order_fact` filter and the block shows nothing until it does. This file lists no facts, because any such value is one; a value that does not read the order, picks fixed words by an order field, joins words a binding format cannot hold, or fits several keys is still a problem row.

choices._about: A value that picks one of two fixed phrases by one fact of the order (lib/template-piece-order-read.mjs::choiceOf) becomes one block per phrase, each with its Show-to rule (F-12). A choice by a field of the order itself (`o.createAccount ? 'a' : 'b'`) is the choice whose `words` hit a segment of the field's path, and whose `group`'s words hit the path or what the draft's order action made the field from; the phrase shown when the field is set takes `shown`, the other `hidden`. A choice by a field equal to a fixed word (`method === 'collect'`) is the choice whose `words` hit the field's last segment and whose `values` (exactly two Show-to rules, each with the words of the value it stands for) name the word; the other phrase takes the other rule. Every rule must be one the framework database lists for the Show-to setting.
